headline: Get one Quando? version ready to install by Thursday midnight.

deadlines.title: One app version ready
deadlines.note: Android Quando? release candidate, plus the iPad rebuild. No new features before then.

deadlines.title: iPad/Mac test builds expire
deadlines.note: Free Apple account: rebuild before this day.

items.title: Ship Quando? release
items.note: Brings the home screen, growth features and voice alarms together into an Android release candidate and rebuilds the iPad app.
items.details: Integrates PRs #22, #24, #25 and #26 into one Android Quando? release candidate and rebuilds the iPad app. Rule until Thursday midnight: no new features, only fixes needed to ship.

items.title: Home screen: slim header, sky/moon/weather on top
items.details: Slim header; sky, moon and weather card back on top; night, moon and weather on by default. Shabbat stays opt-in. Rule from you: always use the newest sky card.

items.title: Home screen: classic layout, clock sizes, movable cards on iPad/Mac
items.details: Classic home with the newest sky card, clock sizes (Large to Off), and on iPad/Mac a movable-card home with a snap grid.

items.title: Loud calendar alarms, Busy mode, share card, Android widget
items.details: Calendar reminders become loud alarms; Busy mode sets Do Not Disturb and can auto-reply; share card for Stories/WhatsApp; Android home-screen widget. Not yet done: video of the sky, Slack status, iOS widget.

items.title: Say or type an alarm (voice alarms)
items.note: Choice still open: add an on-device AI fallback or keep the parser only.
items.details: A sentence, spoken or typed, becomes an alarm, parsed on the device in English, Portuguese and Hebrew. Open choice: add an on-device AI fallback for sentences the parser can't read.

items.title: Discreet calendar lock
items.note: Locks the phone during and between calendar events. Shabbat visuals only when a Shabbat calendar is picked. Separate branch, not part of the release.
items.details: Locks during and between calendar events. Shabbat visuals only if a Shabbat calendar is picked; Shabbat is never the default. Own branch, not part of the release.

items.title: Project dashboard (this site)
items.details: This site. Edit dashboard/data.json on GitHub to change it.

items.title: Play Store launch
items.note: Needs a Play developer account and a 14-day closed test with 12 testers before going public.
items.details: A new personal Play account needs a closed test with 12 testers for 14 days before going public. Listing and privacy-policy drafts exist.

items.title: Apple Developer account and TestFlight
items.note: Enrollment was blocked by an unknown error. Support message drafted.
items.details: Enrollment was blocked by an unknown error and a support message is drafted. Until it works, iPad builds are free-account test builds that expire after about 7 days.

items.title: Spotify and YouTube in the app
items.note: Public Spotify sign-in needs a registered company, so version 1.0 opens songs in the Spotify app instead.
items.details: Public Spotify sign-in needs a registered company and a large user base, so 1.0 opens songs in the Spotify app. YouTube sign-in needs Google verification before public launch.

items.title: Tuya / Smart Life sign-in
items.note: Waiting on Tuya to link accounts to the cloud project.
items.details: Sign in with just the Smart Life login through a small free relay. Blocked until Tuya links accounts to the cloud project.

items.title: Translations (20 languages)
items.details: 20 languages including right-to-left already exist; new strings need translating each time.

items.title: New logo
items.details: The Q-hand logo exists; a new one is on hold.

items.title: Mac app
items.note: iPad and Android only for now.
items.details: Native Mac apps exist from the Codex work but are paused. Only iPad and Android are built for now.

items.title: Redesign, localization, Matai?, sync, calendar picker
items.details: Earlier work already merged into main.

items.details: Pricing, editions and the three-app idea are proposals until you confirm.

items.details: Choice: parser plus optional on-device AI (recommended), parser only, or AI only.

items.details: Needed for the Play closed test.
